info.title: Invoice Approval Platform API
info.description: API for the Invoice Approval Platform

post.description:
Get an access token for authentication.

In a real application, this would validate against Azure AD.
For this demo, we're simulating authentication with mock users.

Login with Azure AD credentials.

This endpoint validates the Azure AD token and creates a user if they don't exist.
Only users from the mote.consulting organization are allowed.

get.description: Get the current user's information

post.description:
Logout the current user.

This endpoint acknowledges the logout request. The actual token invalidation
happens on the client side by removing the token from storage.

In a more complete implementation, we would add the token to a blacklist
to invalidate it server-side.

get.description: Get all users (approver only).

schema.title: Response Get Users Api Users  Get

get.description:
Get a specific user.

Users can only get their own information unless they are approvers.

put.description:
Update a user's spending limits (admin only).

This endpoint allows setting annual limits for each user. Accrued limits
are calculated elsewhere based on the current date.

get.description:
Get invoices.

Normal users can only see their own invoices.
Approvers can see all invoices.

schema.title: Response Get Invoices Api Invoices  Get

get.description:
Get a specific invoice.

Normal users can only see their own invoices.
Approvers can see all invoices.

put.description:
Update an invoice.

Users can only update their own invoices that are in 'rejected' status.

delete.description:
Delete an invoice.

Users can only delete their own invoices that are in 'pending' status.

post.description:
Submit an invoice that was previously in SUBMITTED status (over accrued limits).

This changes the status from SUBMITTED to PENDING and updates the spending limits.
Only the owner of the invoice can submit it.

get.description:
Get dashboard statistics.

Normal users get stats for their own invoices.
Approvers and Admins get stats for all invoices.

Export invoices to Excel with various filter options.

Supports filtering by:
- Submission date range
- Invoice date range
- Expense type
- Vendor NIF
- User (collaborator)
- Status
- Amount range

Returns an Excel file with invoice data formatted in a table.
Maximum 10,000 records per export.

post.description:
Create multiple invoices at once distributed across users.

Only approvers can use this endpoint.
- All invoices get same vendor/description from request
- Each item specifies user_id and their allocated amount
- All invoices created with status=APPROVED, type=COMPANY
- Optionally save distribution as template for reuse
- Returns invoice IDs + spending limit warnings (non-blocking)

Note: invoice_number will be duplicated across all batch items (represents
the single vendor invoice being distributed). This is intentional for
reconciliation with e-fatura.

get.description:
List saved batch templates.

Only approvers can access templates.
Returns all templates with item counts.

schema.title: Response List Batch Templates Api Invoices Batch Templates Get

get.description:
Get template details to prefill form.

Only approvers can access templates.
Returns template with full item details (user_ids and amounts).

Get all invoices for approval.

Only available to approvers.

schema.title: Response Get Invoices For Approval Api Approvals Invoices Get

post.description:
Approve an invoice.

Only available to approvers.

Pay an invoice.

Approvers may pay an invoice directly or mark approved invoices as payed.

Reject an invoice.

Only available to approvers.

Submit an invoice that was previously in SUBMITTED status for approval.

This is used when limits change (e.g., new month) and the user wants to submit
an invoice that was previously above limits.

get.description:
Get the approval history for an invoice.

Normal users can only see history for their own invoices.
Approvers can see history for all invoices.

schema.title: Response Get Approval History Api Approvals History  Invoice Id  Get

post.description:
Upload an e-fatura Excel file for reconciliation.

Validates:
- File type (Excel: .xlsx, .xls)
- File size (max 20MB)
- Row count (max 50k)

Returns:
- upload_id: Use this to inspect the file structure or start a reconciliation job

get.description:
Inspect an uploaded e-fatura file to view its structure.

Returns:
- Detected headers with sample values
- Row and column counts
- Sample data rows
- Warnings about missing expected columns

This helps you understand the file structure before starting reconciliation.

post.description:
Start a reconciliation job for an uploaded e-fatura file.

Validates:
- Upload exists and hasn't expired
- Date range is valid (date_start < date_end)
- Required columns are present in the file
- Job queue is not full

Returns:
- job_id: Use this to check status and retrieve results

get.description:
Get the current status of a reconciliation job.

Returns:
- Current job status (PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED)
- Progress percentage (0-100)
- Timestamps for start and finish
- Error message if failed

Use this endpoint to poll for job completion.
Recommended polling interval: 2-5 seconds.

post.description:
Request cancellation of a reconciliation job.

Behavior:
- If job is PENDING (queued) or RUNNING, mark as FAILED with message 'Canceled by user'
- Set in-memory cancel flag so worker can skip/stop processing safely
- If job already COMPLETED/FAILED, return current status (idempotent)

Permissions: job owner or ADMIN.

get.description:
Get reconciliation result summary and discrepancies in JSON format.

Returns:
- Result summary: total amounts, match counts, processing time
- Discrepancies list with full details
- Chart-ready datasets for visualization

Only available for COMPLETED jobs. Cached for 1 hour.

Download reconciliation results as formatted Excel file.

The Excel workbook contains:
- Sheet 'Resumo': Summary statistics and key metrics
- Sheet 'E-Fatura': Original parsed data from uploaded file
- Sheet 'aXel': Internal system invoices for the date range
- Sheet 'Incoerências': Detailed list of all discrepancies with suggestions

Color-coded by severity: Red (HIGH), Yellow (MEDIUM), Green (LOW)

Get Chart.js-compatible datasets for reconciliation visualization.

Returns datasets for:
- Pie chart: Reconciliation status (matched, missing in system, missing in efatura)
- Bar chart: Discrepancies by severity (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW)
- Bar chart: Top 20 suppliers with discrepancies

Use directly with Chart.js or similar charting libraries.

Get all reconciliation discrepancy types with descriptions.

Query Parameters:
- lang: Language code (en or pt-PT, default: pt-PT)

schema.title: Response Get Discrepancy Types Api Reconciliation Enums Discrepancy Types Get

SpendingLimitSummary.title: SpendingLimitSummary
SpendingLimitSummary.description:
Summary of spending limits for a user or all users (admin view).

Attributes:
    annual_limit: Annual spending limit (fixed)
    accrued_limit: Accrued budget for year-to-date = annual_limit / 12 * current_month_of_year
    used: Total amount used (PAYED or APPROVED status for specified year)
    pending: Total pending approval (PENDING status for specified year, 0 for BONUS)
    available: Remaining accrued balance = accrued_limit - used - pending
